ideas.title: Investigating the Trump Administration's Immigration Policies
ideas.description: This story would investigate the Trump administration's immigration policies, including the use of force against protesters and the handling of asylum seekers.
questions: What are the key components of the Trump administration's immigration policies?
How have these policies been implemented and what have been the consequences?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to reveal significant wrongdoing and corruption. I will analyze financial records and conduct interviews with key individuals to determine the extent to which the Trump administration's immigration policies have been driven by financial interests.

ideas.title: Examining the Use of Shell Companies in the Trump Organization
ideas.description: This story would examine the use of shell companies in the Trump Organization, including their purpose and the extent to which they have been used to conceal financial dealings.
questions: What are the key characteristics of the shell companies used by the Trump Organization?
How have these shell companies been used to conceal financial dealings?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to reveal significant financial wrongdoing. I will analyze financial records and conduct interviews with key individuals to determine the extent to which the Trump Organization has used shell companies to conceal financial dealings.
